profile_text.body:
Rackspace Technology is a public company traded under the ticker RXT, and it describes itself as a cloud computing services pioneer that delivers multicloud solutions across apps, data, and security. Its site positions the company around what it calls an Enterprise AI Cloud, a secure, regulated, and compliant foundation intended to help customers run AI on current AI-optimized hardware. Rackspace says its engineers embed directly in customer environments to build, deploy, and operate AI workloads in production, and that it remains accountable for outcomes after deployment. It also says it has assembled partners across every layer of the stack to connect models, platform, and infrastructure into a governed system for enterprise AI in regulated environments.

The site emphasizes security, compliance, data sovereignty, and uptime as foundational to the enterprise AI clouds it operates, particularly in regulated and high-stakes settings. It cites customers in Financial Services, Healthcare, and Government, and includes a quote from Dr. Zafar Chaudry, MD, Senior VP, Chief Digital Officer and Chief AI and Information Officer at Seattle Children's Hospital. Rackspace frames its history as moving from hosting to cloud to enterprise AI, and describes itself as the trusted operator of the full enterprise AI stack, from governed private cloud to AI inference and agents in production.

The company's SEC filing record lists CIK 0001810019. No lawsuits, MCP servers, or specific products are recorded in the available facts.
